tests.scope: Pure scalar fixtures and mocked subprocess/GPU/process-clock helpers; no real process/model/GPU launch.

review_fixes_verified.finding: Outer processing reserve was checked only for initial admission, not every later stage or active global stop.
review_fixes_verified.resolution: Every stage requires all remaining quota+cleanup+clock-error fit before DEADLINE minus outer reserve; active cutoff also preserves outer reserve.

review_fixes_verified.finding: Late observation of a nonzero implementation error could mark quota_expired and authorize later inference without a quota intervention.
review_fixes_verified.resolution: Nonzero exit now requires quota_stop_initiated; late observation alone aborts. Explicit saved failed_attempt error types outside KeyboardInterrupt/TimeoutError abort even after quota intervention. New late_error regression passes.

checks: Default invocation is description-only. Root release fixes dataset-specific evaluator hash, exact Sand/Goop host A4/B2 schedule, all four distinct stages and unchanged 7200/1800/1800/900-second quotas plus15seconds cleanup each.

Explicit cost_basis is fixed_execution_allocation_not_empirical_full_horizon_forecast. Whole cohort metrics admission, complete outcome promises, automated retry and v1gate reinterpretation remain false.

Absolute Python/evaluator/input paths and hashes, checkpoint/helper hash argv, shared cohort/protocol and owned unique output paths checked; duplicate/unknown options and resume attempts refused. Goop test stages require acquisition/context/auxiliary/cross-split audit paths.

Outer spawn-to-exit monotonic clocks include imports/checks/computation/IO; inner evaluator max_seconds is not relied on as the sole bound. Fresh bounded clock assessment and latest-start constraints retained.

Each child registered before fallible identity check; exact parent/argv/start ownership through pinned lifecycle before group signals; SIGINT/TERM/KILL schedule and unreaped cleanup bound retained. No subsequent stage after unresolved owned cleanup or nonquota error.
Async read-only GPU inventory does not block deadline loop; mismatched physical GPU assignments or unrelated active processes abort. No other host work is launched.
Fixed cell lists preserve180 full outcomes,150 same-state frames per split and128 clean frames per model; exact Sand andGoop target/horizon distinctions verified.

Coverage separately retains committed complete and failed rows, timed-out current, unfinished/unknown missing and never-started stages. It does not relabel missing executions as model guard failures, calculate survivor means or admit scientific metrics.
Post-stop accounting occurs after owned children are reaped; if unresolved, coverage is deferred. Malformed final row/changed pinned input becomes retained audit error.
All input pins rechecked before execution and after coverage processing; raw worker failed_attempt and process/signal evidence retained.
limits: This review does not launch or authenticate an actual root release, establish measured Goop throughput, or guarantee full scientific outcomes within quotas.
Coverage validates committed JSON identity/status and full-rollout horizon only; root must separately verify referenced NPZ/array bytes, checkpoints, scientific values and paired estimands.
The positive outer processing reserve must be justified and chosen in root release; source validation alone does not establish its adequacy.
Fixed source/policy order can select quota survivors. Required complete-sample MSE/paired contrasts remain null for failed or missing observations.
Real OS scheduling, process cleanup and external-source integrity remain operationally monitored; mocked lifecycle tests are not empirical timing measurements.
